code='''def transform(grid):
    pts8=[(r,c) for r,row in enumerate(grid) for c,v in enumerate(row) if v==8]
    r0=min(r for r,c in pts8); r1=max(r for r,c in pts8); c0=min(c for r,c in pts8); c1=max(c for r,c in pts8)
    shape=[[grid[r][c] for c in range(c0,c1+1)] for r in range(r0,r1+1)]
    marks=[(r,c) for r,row in enumerate(grid) for c,v in enumerate(row) if v==4]
    copies=[(r0,c0)]
    if len(marks)>=2:
        dr=marks[1][0]-marks[0][0]; dc=marks[1][1]-marks[0][1]
        # Rotate marker vector clockwise, as in the demonstrations.
        copies.append((r0+dc,c0-dr))
    minr=min(r for r,c in copies); minc=min(c for r,c in copies)
    maxr=max(r+len(shape)-1 for r,c in copies); maxc=max(c+len(shape[0])-1 for r,c in copies)
    out=[[0]*(maxc-minc+1) for _ in range(maxr-minr+1)]
    for ar,ac in copies:
        for i,row in enumerate(shape):
            for j,v in enumerate(row):
                if v: out[ar-minr+i][ac-minc+j]=v
    return out
'''
